# vcp_affinity_group (Data Source)

Fetches information about a specific affinity group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a single affinity group by ID.
data "vcp_affinity_group" "example" {
  id = vcp_affinity_group.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Affinity group ID

### Read-Only

- `location_id` (String) Location ID
- `name` (String) Affinity group name
- `policy` (String) Placement policy: 'affinity' or 'anti-affinity'
- `server_ids` (Set of String) Set of server IDs in this group
